content.label: Helps me to remember tasks as a senior

I’m really frustrated with the fact that you can’t download this app and start using mid-streak, I.e. you can’t customize your habit to start on day 10 instead of day one. This is useless unless you’re starting a new streak. I was looking forward to have a tracker to help visualize the work I’m putting in.

title.label: Could use more data analysis options

content.label: I love how simple but versatile this app is. It makes it very easy to make different goals to track many different kinds of habits. The one thing I wish they would add is being able to see partially completed tasks. For example I have a task that needs to be completed 2 times a day. I wish I could see the days where I made progress but didn’t complete instead of just “completed” and “not fully completed”. An update with this feature would make the app perfect!!

This is such a great app.  It is easy to use and the ability to customize the aesthetics of it are endless.  I also like the ability to customize some of the tools, like the note section, for instance, where I’m able to record information such as what work out I accomplished, how long I stayed in the sauna, stuff like that.   I especially love the pause function on certain tasks, especially now that I find myself in a boot from the podiatrist and can’t reach some of my tasks but don’t want to lose my streaks.  I’d give this app 10 stars if I could.

title.label: Great app. A few UI glitches on Mac and Watch keep it from 5 stars

content.label:
This has been a very useful tool for establishing daily and weekly habits. The recurrence rules are flexible, and the multi-page layout makes it easy to move in and out of parts of life (work, home, etc.) 

One star off because the Mac app has some UI issues that make it confusing and hard to configure page layout if you resize the window.

Start of 2025 > when i click the tabs i made as widgets it does not direct me to my tasks interest the app. ( used to before 2025)  It’s all empty. If i create new task with a new widget same issue. And seems new widget format can only display max 3 tasks in one row, earlier i could show max 4 tasks. Please fix so i can update this review
I love this app I use it every day to track my habits. Taking pills, steps, exercise, time outside, and weekly chores. It is a great tool to hold yourself accountable

Its straightforward at what it says it does, and delivers great with a clean and simple interface. Nothing complicated and not too many options. Great and simple. Love it!! Thanks so much to the creators for making this a OTP. Love this app sm!!!! Absolutely worth the purchase.
Love this app! There are few apps that capture this much functionality, and usefulness in such a simple and pleasing interface. This is a must have app!
The UI/UX is very bad. I find myself just tapping on various spots on the screen because it’s not clear what anything does.

Only had the app for little over a week, and so far I’m enjoying it. I am finding I wish I could add more than they allow, and I wish I could color code more than the six on a screen. for instance, I have eight health related habits I’m trying to track, and I would like to colorcode all eight health related habits the same color. But the overall app works great.

I’m not one to struggle with unusual layouts or whatever, but the only flaw of this app is the at times really unclear/confusing user interface. Lots of unintuitive swiping and unclear pathways. Otherwise great.

They really need to review their UX. I’ve never had such a hard time navigating an app before. Additionally, "smart reminders" are quite dumb and the apple watch extension is non-functional. I can’t believe I paid for this.

title.label: Good but can you decrease task circle size

content.label: I like this but u don’t like swiping across three pages. Can I make the circle smaller so more fit on one page
This just deleted every streak I’d accumulated for the past year. For no reason. I will never use this again. Why would I. There is no explanation for why it did it. It could happen again. 😡😡😡

This is a nice app. One I need to keep track of and help me develop healthy habits. One suggestion that would make it over the top awesome...the widget icon....I can add my streak categories and it is PERFECT......can you do the same thing on my home display? So, instead of opening the app to mark the streak, could you make on the home screen the same as the widget where I can just tap and hold each task? That would be sooooo nice. I know I can do that on the widget, but it would be nice to have that same feature just hanging out on my Home Screen. Thank you.
A great onetime purchase habit tracking app that connects to apple health and allows for great habit customization.

I and surely others struggle to keep up with their logging duties. Even the 2-3 taps to get into the app and log might be too much. The new Siri API for using AirPods / head shakes to interact would be SO great. “Hey, have you completed <brush teeth> today?” —> shake head yes or no to quickly log. This would be amazing.
Perfect app for what i was looking for.

The simplicity, ease of use, straightforwardness and beauty of this app make it an absolutely incredible tool!  It’s very rewarding to complete all the tasks you set for yourself in a day and try to get the highest streak in all of them! I’ve been more consistent about doing things like practicing the guitar, reading, working out, stretching and even using the negative task feature to stop myself from playing phone games (which I can be helplessly addicted too).  I have recommended this app to so many people already and if you’re reading this take it as a sign to get it for yourself!  It costs the same as a coffee and will help you be much more productive and to stay on top of doing the things you know you need to do everyday😊. 

Notes for the designers:  making this available for the home screen in the form of a widget or wallpaper would be incredible! Also more choices for colors on the gradients would be a nice feature too! Four is pretty good but it would be fun to choose from more.  And thank you so much!!!
Suddenly can’t be used as a complication

I’m a habit girly - this is the app my life has been needing. This is literally the best app ever and I could not recommend it enough. On my home page I’m tracking walking my dog, flossing my teeth, drinking water, journaling and exercise. You could even throw in a call to your parents on a weekly or monthly basis and it’ll help remind you. Want to do dry January? It’ll help you track that too. It’s truly awesome I’m obsessed.

This is one of the only apps I’ve ever paid to download (as opposed to a subscription), but it’s definitely worth the cost of admission. It all just works! Every feature meshes with other features perfectly, and the Mac companion syncs flawlessly. Excellent!
Recommended by my therapist as a way to track short term goals. It excels at that. The UX is so simple & encourages you to take meaningful steps.

Even though it has some flaws, I had been enjoying Streaks since I purchased it about 2 months ago. This morning I woke up to find all my data erased. Nothing. All gone. Completely enraging. I would like my money back!

Use to work generally fine but recently the app has updated to break widgets, shortcuts, add an advertisement, and remove the daily display feature for the lock screen. Very unfortunate but I have since moved to other, more fission Al apps like BLOCKYTIME.

This app is fine. But it’s relatively simple and it costs money, so it’s frustrating that it’s so buggy. Some days I don’t get a notification, some days I do and when I go into the app it still shows yesterday’s streaks. You have one job and you don’t do it well or consistently. Maybe this app needs its own streak app.

I love this app, and use it daily to improve God habits and break bad habits. The app is clean, easy to use, and yet has an immense amount of capabilities. Developers are very helpful and responsive. I strongly recommend.

My tasks keep randomly disappearing and I have to constantly re-add them, not to mention I lose my streak. This is the whole purpose of the app, so it’s frustrating that it doesn’t function correctly.
Easy to use, and very helpful.

Please add stopwatch functionality, as it serves a totally different purpose than a timer. 

A stopwatch function is a must have feature, because I and many others not only want a goal of say 30 minutes a day for walking, reading, meditating etc., but if we do more than 30 minutes we want credit for that. And when you add this awesome feature please include the ability to manually change the time, thank you!

Everything else is great except for widgets; I would set up some mini charts widgets and every once in a while they would reset all the widget settings (such as setting a specific task) making them useless since it's a hassle to reconfigure all of them if I have multiple.
but the main interface remains still confusing. The principle of the filtration evades me for some reason.
Often deletes my tasks and streaks without warning. Unacceptable as a paying customer.

yeah the widgets don’t live update after using official shortcuts provided. it does after we click and wait for them the app to load up then update.

the whole point of using this app was for intuitivity and its main features it did had were taken away; especially the feature that let us update task status live on the widget itself. 

we might as well use the reminders app to check things off & track things.
 
its disappointing to have things we paid for and an update takes this away
It works great to build habits. Sleek look. Wish they also had one-time tasks so we could also use this as a todo list.

Other than that, this is a pretty great app. Maybe you could use some better colors. I seem to like it better than all the other habit tracking apps I’ve tried. I love that. It’s simple, easily customizable and no frills. My quality of life has significantly improved after using this daily for the last several weeks.

widgets are working now, but now my data is gone? only see empty screens when i open the app :’( 

i miss my calendar widget :( please fix

There’s one feature that could take this app from good to great. Each task should have a small timer beneath it. When you open the app it would be so helpful to see at a glance how much time is left or has passed since you last completed the task. This kind of visual reminder could enhance productivity and give a better sense of urgency for certain tasks. If the developers were to include this time feature streaks would easily become a five star app. Other than that, it’s still a fantastic tool for positive habits and improvement.

Organizing my tasks by the type of task is how I want to use this product, and 4 pages does not allow me to create the categories of tasks that I need.  There are all sorts of ways someone may want to use a task app and while I find the user interface here to be superior to the competition it simply can’t expand to meet my needs.

There are a lot of streaks apps out there. I happened to get this one. I added a task “go climbing” that I want to do twice a week. 

To my surprise the icon automatically changed to a figure climbing with ropes.

Little bits of delight such as this one are what make using apps a pleasure.

It’s a good app that is a great value if you only plan on using on one device. Soon as you introduce iCloud Sync it completely breaks down with issues of recreating old habits and not syncing progress
